chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Replacing Fats Waller in Katie Crippen's act; June Clark and Sonny Greer
summary: Basie confirms replacing Waller in a traveling vaudeville act, and working with trumpeter June Clark and Sonny Greer, partly in New York.
